answer: GLACIER-ECHO LEDGER: attestations accumulate in a VDF-paced glacier, one layer per epoch, so depth is provable age. Each layer tip is split by a public prism into k shard commitments, so a forked glacier is detectable from any single shard. An echo — a replayed attestation — is checked against glacier depth: a claimed timestamp older than your own depth is invalid, and a fresh sybil must actually run the VDF to reach that depth. Attacker cost: a full glacier build per fake identity plus k-shard verification per layer, and every replay fails the depth check.
